answer: The lantern report makes public the merge explicitly at each terrace. Each collapsed cluster gets one ocean weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an hostile operator who spins up 75 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 143 times the capital for one share. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 28 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
